old.quote: Although addition of pictilisib to fulvestrant did not significantly improve progression-free survival, dosing of pictilisib was limited by toxicity, potentially limiting its efficacy.
old.note: FERGI dosed pictilisib at 340 mg, above the 330 mg where tumour pAkt fell >90%; PFS missed, dose cut to 260 mg, program dropped. Combination with fulvestrant, scored like any trial. Dated to FERGI part 1 at SABCS December 2014 (earliest public).
old.reason: Reached, failed, abandoned in this setting
old.judgement: Dose scored on its own prediction (rule v4): 340 mg was at or above the 330 mg where tumour pAkt fell >90%. Part 1 gave 340 mg daily, at or above the 330 mg RP2D where Sarker 2015 showed >90% tumour pAkt suppression, so the model's pathway-inhibition exposure was reached; the primary endpoint missed and Roche stopped pictilisib in this setting, which is the 'reached, failed, abandoned' row (contra derived from efficacy). Part 2's cut to 260 mg for toxicity is not scored as blocked_by because Raynaud 2009 stated no tolerability margin. Buparlisib on the same track would be same: its 100 mg/day MTD showed clear target inhibition (Bendell 2012) and BELLE-2 met its primary at that dose; one drug's contra beats another's same on one track, so it sits in this judgement. PEGGY dosed 260 mg on days 1-5 only, below the daily target, and also failed.

old.judgement: Scored on the harm the species could have shown: rodents and dogs can show transaminase elevation, the discovery paper called the preclinical safety profile supportive, and grade 3-4 ALT rises hit a quarter of BELLE-2 patients, liver toxicity suspended NeoPHOEBE, and BELLE-2 concluded no further studies would be pursued because of toxicity. Mood alteration, a buparlisib DLT from the phase 1 (Bendell 2012) that drove the discontinuations, is not scored: a xenograft study cannot show it. Hyperglycaemia is on-target and was read as target modulation in the phase 1s, so it is not a miss. Pictilisib's FERGI toxicity is scored on its own track (safety entry 4). Counted once, here, because no member's model predicted it.

rule_questions: Dose: when the model's stated exposure target was reached but patients' tumour pharmacodynamics show it was too low (pictilisib: tumour pAkt >90% only above AUC 20 h·µM, over three times the 6 h·µM target), is that a dose contra ('target too low') without a later higher dose that worked? Here the higher exposure (FERGI 340 mg) was given and also missed, so the draft keeps same.

Efficacy, patient-level track: BELLE-2's co-primaries split (all patients met; PI3K-activated missed). The co-primary rule scores a trial as its authors call it, which suits a class-level track; the draft scores the genotype track on the co-primary that carries its prediction (contra). Confirm.
Model side from a sponsor protocol posted to a registry (BERIL-1): does it count as tier 3 for model_src, and does its upload date (2018) date the comparison it verifies?
